test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 20 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The pie chart given below show the runs scored by a batsman in five innings. Total runs scored by the batsman in all these five innings are 800. Runs scored by the batsman in a particular innings is shown as a percentage of runs scored in all these five innings.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5a56621c38b2011393f49730202c8e2c33c43abe5e977ec71724ba2472cc51cc.png] 

What is the difference between runs scored in S and U?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Difference between runs scored in S and U = (31 - 12)/100 × 800

19/100 × 800 = 152

**Difference between runs scored in S and U is 152.**
